title: Greek Witnesses of Nag Hammadi Texts — The Gospel of Thomas Oxyrhynchus Fragments (DCLP EpiDoc)
witness_pairing: First executed Greek-Coptic witness pairing across corpora: these three fragments are the earlier language stratum of the work seated in Coptic at coptic-gnostic/ (NHC II,2, EA-CORPORA-01). The Greek fragments antedate the Coptic codex by a century or more and derive from three DIFFERENT copies — three independent witnesses in one town's rubbish.
